claims.claim: Brazil’s government is expected to keep a diesel subsidy of 2.12 reais per litre for another 30 days, and Planning Minister Bruno Moretti said it will be extended.
claims.episode_span: Planning Minister Bruno Moretti said the subsidy will be extended.
claims.source_title: Às vésperas das eleições, governo deve manter subvenção de R$ 2,12 por litro do diesel por mais 30 dias
claims.supporting_quote: Por isso, o ministro do Planejamento, Bruno Moretti, disse que a subvenção será prorrogada.

claims.claim: The combined diesel subsidy of 2.12 reais loses effect on Saturday, and extra fuel benefits cost the Union 7 billion reais a month.
claims.episode_span: those extra fuel-price benefits cost the Union seven billion reais a month.
claims.source_title: Às vésperas das eleições, governo deve manter subvenção de R$ 2,12 por litro do diesel por mais 30 dias
claims.supporting_quote: Junto com a nova subvenção do diesel, os benefícios adicionais sobre os preços dos combustíveis custam R$ 7 bilhões aos cofres da União por mês.

claims.claim: Retired colonel Ariel Guzmán resigned as administrator of the military health fund a day after meeting Defense Minister Carlos Presti, with Iosfa provider debt of 213 billion pesos.
claims.episode_span: the old Instituto Obra Social de las Fuerzas Armadas still owes providers 213 billion pesos.
claims.source_title: Renunció el administrador de la obra social de los militares y la crisis se profundiza
claims.supporting_quote: Mientras la nueva estructura –OSFA– recibe los aportes de los afiliados, la antigua Iosfa mantiene una deuda de $213.000 millones con prestadores de todo el país.

claims.claim: ASJ counted 926 bills in Honduras’s Congress from January 25 to June 30, 2026, with 140 approved and 786 pending.
claims.episode_span: 926 bills filed in Honduras’s National Congress between January 25 and June 30, of which 140 were approved
claims.source_title: Congreso de Honduras deja 786 proyectos pendientes pese a mayor actividad legislativa en el primer semestre de 2026
claims.supporting_quote: El estudio contabilizó 926 proyectos presentados , de los cuales 140 fueron aprobados , equivalente a aproximadamente el 15% . Los otros 786 permanecían pendientes al cierre del período analizado.

claims.claim: The weekly Niño 3.4 anomaly centered on September 16 reached plus 3 degrees Celsius, and all 22 models project a very strong El Niño.
claims.episode_span: the weekly Niño 3.4 reading centered on September 16 reached plus 3 degrees Celsius
claims.source_title: Anticipan que el Súper Niño alcanzará su pico en las próximas semanas
claims.supporting_quote: Su registro semanal, centrado en el 16 de septiembre , llegó a +3 °C , después de que el promedio mensual de agosto alcanzara +2,52 °C .

claims.claim: At least seven people were injured when a school minibus hit a trailer truck at the Ticsa bridge in San Salvador.
claims.episode_span: At least seven people, including students, were hurt Thursday morning
claims.source_title: Microbús escolar chocó contra una rastra dejando al menos siete lesionados en San Salvador
claims.supporting_quote: Al menos siete personas resultaron lesionadas , entre ellas varios estudiantes que se dirigían a sus centros educativos.

claims.claim: President Sheinbaum said the FGR is still reviewing permits related to 59 million litres of fuel seized in Guanajuato.
claims.episode_span: still reviewing permits tied to 59 million litres of fuel seized in Guanajuato
claims.source_title: FGR sigue revisando permisos, dice CSP de presunto huachicol
claims.supporting_quote: Sheinbaum afirmó que la FGR aún revisa los permisos relacionados con los 59 millones de litros de combustible asegurados en Guanajuato.

claims.claim: Dr Gabrielle Henry told Good Morning America she had not tripped and was told she had an intracranial hemorrhage.
claims.episode_span: she had not tripped on November 19, 2025
claims.source_title: ‘I did not trip’: Dr Gabrielle Henry speaks on terrifying fall in new interview
claims.supporting_quote: When she regained consciousness fully, she was told she had received an intracranial haemorrhage and facial and back injuries.

claims.claim: CACIF backed Guatemala-U.S. cooperation after a meeting that included President Bernardo Arévalo and five U.S. federal prosecutors.
claims.episode_span: CACIF, on September 23 backed tighter cooperation with the United States
claims.source_title: El sector empresarial organizado respalda la cooperación de Guatemala y Estados Unidos contra las redes criminales transnacionales
claims.supporting_quote: La delegación estadounidense reunió por primera vez en Guatemala a cinco fiscales federales nombrados por el presidente Donald Trump y a representantes de nueve distritos federales.

claims.claim: Argentina’s Supreme Court ordered Facebook to remove anonymous posts calling student F.C. an abuser and to identify the account holders, overturning the Federal Chamber of La Plata.
claims.episode_span: ordered Facebook Argentina, the local unit of Meta, to delete anonymous Facebook and Instagram posts
claims.source_title: La Corte Suprema ordenó a Facebook eliminar las publicaciones anónimas que acusaban de “abusador” a un estudiante universitario
claims.supporting_quote: El Tribunal Supremo dejó sin efecto un fallo de la Cámara Federal de La Plata que había rechazado el reclamo de F. C., e hizo lugar a la demanda de habeas data .
